entities.summary: Greek historian (c. 484-425 BCE) known as the "Father of History" for his Histories, the first systematic investigation of past events. His account of the Greco-Persian Wars combined eyewitness research, cultural ethnography, and narrative storytelling, establishing the Western tradition of historical inquiry.
